# Rise and Battle the Day
## Scripture
"Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go." – Joshua 1:9
## Reflection
Men, the alarm goes off and the battle begins. Before your feet hit the floor, the enemy is already whispering: *You're not enough. Today will break you. Why even try?* Joshua heard the same lies on the edge of the Promised Land—giants in the land, fear in his heart, Moses gone. But God didn't offer Joshua a pep talk; He gave him a command: *Be strong and courageous.* Notice the reason—not because Joshua was impressive, but because *the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.* Courage isn't the absence of fear; it's obedience in the presence of fear. Your strength today isn't mustered from within—it's drawn from the God who goes before you into every meeting, every temptation, every hard conversation. So stop waiting to feel brave. Step into the day like a man who knows who stands beside him. The giants don't shrink, but neither does your God. Rise, warrior—the day is yours to take.
## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and on each rep say, "God is with me." Then carry that truth into your first hard moment of the day.
